operations.source_fact: The source lists specific ASI diSPIM hardware, two Nikon objectives, two Flash4.0 cameras and a bottom observation camera.

global_unknowns: robot embodiment, gripper geometry, reach and dexterity
manufacturer CAD, joint limits, port dimensions, fastener torque
physical optical propagation and fluid/biological processes: not modeled
actual hardware controls and live software: not connected
global_rules: all observed scientific images/readings are labeled source_reference or authored_preset
unknown values are null or named inputs, never filled from unscaled photographs
numerical optical examples are provenance facts, not validated robot setpoints
clinical/pathogenic/weaponizable biological agents and constructing new reporter strains are outside this design
routine specimen handling is represented explicitly; hazardous historical practices are substituted transparently
a safe rejection or blocked input is an honest terminal outcome, not experiment success
